approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: Amino acid, any of a group of organic molecules that contain a basic amino group (NH2) and an acidic carboxyl group (COOH).
approved_classes.ex:Protein: Protein is made up of amino acids, which are the building blocks of the molecule.
approved_classes.ex:ChemicalSubstance: A general class for chemical substances.
approved_classes.ex:Element: Element, a fundamental substance in chemistry.
approved_classes.ex:BiologicalProcess: A process related to biological functions.
approved_classes.ex:Disease: A condition that impairs the normal functioning of an organism.
approved_classes.ex:ChemicalReaction: A process where one or more substances are transformed into one or more new substances.
approved_classes.ex:PhysicalProperty: A property that can be observed without changing the chemical identity of a substance.
approved_classes.ex:OpticalProperty: A property related to the interaction of light with a substance.
approved_classes.ex:Classification: A method of categorizing or organizing things into groups.
approved_classes.ex:AliphaticAminoAcid: Amino acids with aliphatic side chains.
approved_classes.ex:AlphaAminoAcid: Amino acids with the amino group attached to the next carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:BetaAminoAcid: Amino acids with the amino group attached to the third carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:GammaAminoAcid: Amino acids with the amino group attached to the fourth carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used to make fat.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be metabolized into both ketogenic and glucogenic pathways.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be used as a starting point for the production of glucose or glycogen.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: Amino acids with no charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are not synthesized in the human body and must be obtained from food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that can be synthesized in the human body.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acids that are required in the diet of growing children but not for mature individuals.
approved_classes.ex:Cysteine: Cysteine is used in medicine to boost the efficiency of corticosteroid medications.
approved_classes.ex:Cystine: L-Cystine can be used in the treatment of surgery and trauma.
approved_classes.ex:Tyrosine: Tyrosine is commonly used in the production of thyroid hormone.
approved_classes.ex:Threonine: Threonine is used to treat spinal spasticity, multiple sclerosis, familial spastic paraparesis, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
approved_classes.ex:Proline: L-proline supplements are used to improve joint and skin health.
approved_classes.ex:Hydroxyproline: Hydroxyproline is required for the formation of collagen, the body's principal structural protein.
approved_classes.ex:AsparticAcid: Aspartic acid is occasionally used to treat stress and exhaustion.
approved_classes.ex:Asparagine: Asparagine is necessary for brain development and function.
approved_classes.ex:GlutamicAcid: Glutamic acid serves as a source of energy for the brain.
approved_classes.ex:BetaHydroxyGlutamicAcid: Beta-hydroxy glutamic acid is used to treat acne, photoaging, dry skin, psoriasis, and melasma.
approved_classes.ex:Glutamine: Glutamine is used to keep blood sugar levels under control and consistent.
approved_classes.ex:Ornithine: L-ornithine is primarily used in health supplements to support sports and performance.
approved_classes.ex:Arginine: L-arginine is a non-essential amino acid that may play an important role in the treatment of cardiovascular disease.
approved_classes.ex:Lysine: Lysine appears to minimize cold sores when taken orally and when applied to the skin as a cream.
approved_classes.ex:Histidine: Histidine is used to treat anemia and can reduce blood pressure.
approved_classes.ex:DPenicillamine: D-Penicillamine is used in the chelation therapy of Wilson’s disease.
approved_classes.ex:NAcetylcysteine: N-Acetylcysteine is used in cystic fibrosis and chronic renal insufficiency as an antioxidant.
approved_classes.ex:Gabapentin: Gabapentin is used as an anticonvulsant.
